name: 3MS
description: The 3MS (Modular Multi Material System) is a lane-type multimaterial system for Klipper 3D printers. Each filament lane has its own dedicated BMG-clone extruder driven by a NEMA 17 stepper motor. All lanes feed into a printed Y-splitter that merges into a single bowden tube going to the printer's toolhead extruder. On a tool change, the active lane retracts its filament to a parking position just above the Y-splitter, and the new lane pushes its filament through the shared path to the toolhead. The system is designed for simplicity and low cost.
features: Very low cost (~$150 USD for a 4-unit build, ~$30 per filament unit)
Minimal mechanical complexity (no rails, belts, or servos)
One dedicated BMG-clone extruder per lane
Printed Y-splitter merges all lanes into single path
All parts available on Amazon or as a kit
Modular design: add or remove filament units after building
